verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
ABANTU bonna ab'ensi,
Mukama mumuyimbire!
Mumutye,mumuwulire,
Mujje mumusanyukire.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mukama Katonda waffe
Ye yekka eyatutonda ffe;
ffe yatulonda,ffe babe,
Ffe ndiga z'oku ttale lye.

verse.name: v3
v4
verse.lines:
Mujje mweyanze bulijjo:
Kubanga ye mulungi nnyo;
Tegaliggwa-amazima ge,
Newnkubadde-ekisa kye.
